# Asset provenance

- `ohmi.png`: byte-identical copy of repository `assets/mascot/ohmi-pixel-front.png`. Owner-approved artwork; see `docs/OHMI_MASCOT.md`. SHA-256 `815AD3DFF06433ED9081EF1A73FAC2F97D7943D760E95A9AC11660D11AD39382`. Provenance is recorded here rather than embedded to preserve the exact original PNG.
- `horizon.png`: generated with the built-in image tool for this website, using the owner-approved Concept C as its visual reference. Exact final prompt is embedded in PNG metadata and recorded in `website/design/horizon-final.json`. Decorative image, not a physical circuit simulation.
- `manrope-variable.ttf`: Google Fonts official `ofl/manrope/Manrope[wght].ttf`, retrieved 16 October 2026. SIL OFL; license included as `OFL-Manrope.txt`.
- `special-gothic-variable.ttf`: Google Fonts official `ofl/specialgothic/SpecialGothic[wdth,wght].ttf`, retrieved 16 October 2026. SIL OFL; license included as `OFL-Special-Gothic.txt`.
- `silkscreen-bold.ttf`: Google Fonts official `ofl/silkscreen/Silkscreen-Bold.ttf`, retrieved 16 October 2026. SIL OFL; license included as `OFL-Silkscreen.txt`.
- Inline arrow glyphs use Tabler Icons' `arrow-right` and `arrow-up-right` geometry. MIT license included as `LICENSE-Tabler.txt`. The circuit schematic is original countable vector geometry with accessible labels; no third-party circuit illustration is used.
